title: The Negro Motorist Green Book: 1946
historical_context: Published in 1946 as the first post-World War II edition following the 1942-1945 wartime hiatus, introducing the motto 'Carry your Green Book with you... you may need it' and expanding to 3,335 listings. Preserved in the Library of Congress collection.
